Gen Mkhwanazi outlined a series of events that he asserted resulted in the "orchestrated" dissolution of a task force established in 2018 to look into the murders of politicians, particularly in KwaZulu-Natal.
Last Sunday, the head of KwaZulu-Natal provincial police, Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, was the first to publicly disclose the allegations.

Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi: Gen Mkhwanazi said the team's investigations had uncovered links to high-profile individuals — including politicians, police officials, and businesspeople tied to a drug cartel syndicate - and this is why the team was disbanded.
Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi: The provincial police chief also alleged Mr Mchunu had ties to a controversial businessman who was "financially supporting" the minister's political career.

These explosive allegations were made by KwaZulu-Natal police boss Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi at a press briefing on Sunday.
